Keywords append only native trim strings after nonempty test, or tokens after length >=2; native strlen/mb_strlen of empty string is zero. No callback sees keyword array before deduplication. Remove no-op filter; keep sanitize_text_field, trim, token/error guards and array_unique/array_values.
Native paragraph strlen/mb_strlen lengths are nonnegative integers; array_filter removes zero and count>=3 guards max/min, so maximum is positive. Preserve filtering and rhythm threshold.
citation_annotations is normalized to array; this literal is inside !empty(citation_annotations), hence count positive. Preserve outer guard, count in title and external envelope checks.

Each of two review arrays starts empty and appends only a local literal with slug before summarizing. Preserve string casts and sanitize_key: slug values remain filterable; null converts to same empty string as former default. No quality/approval/readiness checks change.

block_theme_home_template_candidates creates every candidate as literal slug/strategy; no array escapes before dedup. Preserve string cast, sanitizer, empty-slug, duplicate and all option/post guards.
Loop uses four nonempty literal suffix strings, native byte strlen always positive. Preserve title normalization, suffix matching and minimum display-unit guard.

pattern_merge_item_lists and pattern_items initialize accumulator arrays empty; each append is local literal title/description after nonempty guards. No references escape before duplicate scan. Retain casts and all raw/fallback input normalization.
All four blocked row alternatives locally assign a non-null literal blocked_reason before eligible-count filter; external media input guards unchanged.

Private evidence-request helper has one call with the same locally built blocked literal rows. Remove only repeated outer array test; keep reason default, attachment ID normalization/checks, limits and evidence policy.

Same local insertion-map proof; preserve empty guard, insertion order and loop bounds.

retained_cases.proof: Retain mode ?? off: read_plan_mode returns sanitize_key output which can be changed to null by a WordPress sanitize_key filter. Field presence does not prove non-null values. The outer sanitize_key can distinguish former off fallback from empty-string cast, so deleting the default would change filter-observable behavior. No suppression or PHPDoc change.
